questions.question: The average of the first five consecutive odd numbers is m. If the next three odd numbers are also included, then what is the increase in the average?
questions.solution:
The five consecutive odd number are 1, 3, 5, 7, 9

Average of five consecutive odd number = (1 + 3 + 5 + 7 + 9)/5 = 25/5 = 5

So m = 5

If next three odd number are included, then the average of 8 consecutive odd number

(25 + 11 + 13 + 15)/8

⇒ 64/8

⇒ 8

We can write 8 = 5 + 3 or m + 3

The area of the four walls of a room having length 6 m, breadth 4 m and height 4 m, is:
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Length of wall = 6 m

Breadth of wall = 4 m 

Height of wall = 4 m.

**CONCEPT:**

Lateral surface area of a cuboid.

**FORMULA USED :**

Area of four wall = 2 (l + b) × h

CALCULATION :

Area of four wall = 2 (6 + 4) × 4

= 2 × 10 × 4

= 80 m²

**∴ The area of the four walls of a room is 80 m2**

questions.question: Two cars A and B leave from Delhi at 8:30 a.m. and at 9 a.m. to Shimla, respectively. They travel at speeds of 40km/h and 50 km/h respectively. How many kilometres away from Delhi will the two cars be together?
questions.solution:
Speed of first cars = 40 km/hr

Speed of second cars = 50 km/hr

Relative speed, if same direction = 50 – 40 = 10 km/hr

Distance cover by first cars in 1/2 hr = 40 × 1/2 = 20 km

Time = distance/speed

Both cars be together in = 20/10 = 2 hr

Distance cover by second car in next 2 hr to meet first car = 50 × 2 = 100 km

questions.question:
In the figure, if ∠A = 100° then ∠C = ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24a89ab861c670793777c3fbf737b8bcbbfbf9a822ffef9e537a3bb874ce42a0.png]
questions.solution:
**Given:**

∠A = 100° 

**Concept Used:**

The sum of the opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral is 180°.

The sum of interior angles of a triangle is 180°.

**Calculation:**

∠A = 100

As we know,

∠A + ∠C = 180 [opposite angles of cyclic quadrilateral]

⇒ 100 + ∠C = 180

⇒ ∠C = 180 – 100 = 80

**∴ ∠C is 80° **

questions.question: In an examination, Anita scored 31% marks and failed by 16 marks. Sunita scored 40% marks and obtained 56 marks more than those required to pass. Find the minimum marks required to pass.
questions.solution:
Let, maximum marks be x

So, Passing marks = x × (31/100) + 16 ---- (1)

Passing marks = x × (40/100) – 56 ---- (2)

From equation (1) and equation (2),

31x/100 + 16 = 40x/100 – 56

⇒ 40x/100 – 31x/100 = 56 + 16

⇒ 9x/100 = 72

⇒ x = 72 × (100/9)

⇒ x = 800

Passing marks = 800 × 31/100 + 16 = 248 + 16 = 264

**∴ Passing marks is 264.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Let, maximum marks = 100%

40% - 31% = (16 + 56)

⇒ 9% = 72

⇒ 1% = 8

⇒ 100% = 800

**∴ Passing marks = 800 × 31/100 + 16 = 264**

questions.question: By selling 18 tables fans for Rs. 11,664 a man incurs a loss of 10% How many fans should he sell for Rs. 17,424 to earn 10% profit?
questions.solution:
SP of 18 fans = 11664

CP of 18 fans = 11664 × (10/9) = 12960

Now, CP of 1 fans = 12960/18 = 720

New SP of 1 fans = 720 × 11/10 = 792

In Rs. 792, fan sold = 1

∴ In Rs. 17,424, fans sold = 1/792 × 17424 = 22

questions.question: Ten men or twelve women can finish the same work in 10 days. If 5 men and 2 women undertake the work together, how many days will they take to complete the work?
questions.solution:
Let efficiency of 1 man and 1 woman be m and w respectively.

10m = 12w

⇒ m : w = 6 : 5

Total work = 10 × 6 × 10 = 600 units

Work done by 5 men and 2 women in 1 day = 5 × 6 + 2 × 5 = 40

∴ Number of days = 600/40 = 15 days

If the given number 925x85 is divisible by 11, then the smallest value of x is:
questions.solution:
Divisibility law of 11: If the difference of the alternating sum of digits of the number is a multiple of 11 (e.g. 2343 is divisible by 11 because 2 - 3 + 4 - 3 = 0, which is a multiple of 11).

The number 925x85 is divisible by 11, then

9 – 2 + 5 – x + 8 – 5 = 11

⇒ ⇒ 15 – x = 11

⇒ x = 15 – 11

⇒ x = 4
